activation_requirements: evidence that the capability improves on the project's native tool

capabilities.name: Forge Doctor
capabilities.trigger: Explicit environment diagnosis after a concrete environment failure.
known_defects: Legacy remediation can imply repair authority; automatic repair is prohibited.
capabilities.disposition: legacy research only; clean-room diagnose-only replacement is contract-gated in the active core

capabilities.name: Forge Graph
capabilities.trigger: Repeated work establishes enough observed relationships to justify a progressive graph.
known_defects: Legacy graph is built too early and can classify speculative relationships as authoritative.

capabilities.name: Forge Lab
capabilities.trigger: A specific state or failure hypothesis requires a disposable experiment.
known_defects: Legacy Adopt initializes Lab before a real experiment is needed.

capabilities.name: Forge Evidence
capabilities.trigger: Typed evidence volume exceeds the compact Ledger reference model.
known_defects: Legacy evidence is coupled to broad release machinery and first-run state.

capabilities.name: Runtime Proof
capabilities.trigger: A specific HTTP surface needs bounded content-aware runtime evidence.
known_defects: Default contracts can be empty and therefore cannot support broad assurance claims.
capabilities.disposition: legacy research only; clean-room content-aware HTTP replacement is contract-gated in the active core

active_replacement.activation: project-owned fingerprint-bound contract with exact-origin recipe attachments

capabilities.name: Release Proof
capabilities.trigger: An explicit release candidate requires comprehensive scoped assurance.
known_defects: Legacy surface discovery overlaps Graph and can undercount public entrypoints.

capabilities.name: Confidentiality
capabilities.trigger: Packaging, Ship, or an explicit targeted privacy/security scan.
known_defects: Placeholder handling requires explicit project context.

capabilities.name: Legacy Tool Absorb/Migration
capabilities.trigger: None; replace with the Native Tool Registry.
known_defects: Absorbing subordinate scripts obscures the project's canonical quality ecosystem.

capabilities.name: CI Bridge
capabilities.trigger: A stable Git/CI installation stage exists.
known_defects: Premature before Forge has a stable installer and authority contract.

capabilities.name: Forge Update
capabilities.trigger: A stable installer and rollback contract exists.
known_defects: No stable public installation/update contract exists yet.

capabilities.name: Legacy Project Memory
capabilities.trigger: One-way migration of confirmed records into the new Ledger.
known_defects: Over-modeled lifecycle with weak authority and objective recovery.
capabilities.disposition: extract useful records; do not reactivate wholesale
